test_parse_dates_as_index_col: test parsing dates as an index column with read_csv parse_dates and index_col parameters
test_parse_dates_column_list: test parsing multiple date columns by specifying a list of column names in parse_dates parameter
test_parse_dates_tz_aware: test parsing timezone-aware ISO 8601 date strings with read_csv parse_dates parameter
test_parse_dates_dayfirst: test parsing ambiguous day/month dates with dayfirst parameter and validating warnings
test_parse_dates_missing_column: test that read_csv raises ValueError when a column in parse_dates is missing from the CSV
